summary: Aurelion Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a new CEO and Chairman, effective June 30, 2026. Mr. Frank Zheng succeeds Mr. Björn Schmidtke as CEO, and Mr. Chang-Wei Chiu succeeds Mr. Moore Xin Jin as Chairman and Compensation Committee Chair. The departures were not due to any disagreement. Mr. Tokihiko Shimizu was appointed as an independent director. The changes appear planned and are considered routine leadership transitions for scaling the business. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors are disclosed. This is a management change event, but as it is voluntary and not forced/abrupt, it is borderline routine; however, the explicit announcement of a new CEO makes it a special situation under Management Changes.
